title: Onyx
description: A new Performance modpack that also has some nice visuals.
body:
**A new minecraft 1.21 modpack designed for maximum performance.**
Onyx is a work-in-progress *(not really it already works great)* Optimization and Visual Improvement modpack using all the new and best mods for amazingly high fps with or without shaders. On average, with my testing across 3 systems; a random laptop that barely runs windows 10, a windows 11 pc with a ryzen 5 2600 and a gtx 1070 ti, and a windows 11 pc with a ryzen 5 8400f and an rtx 5050, i get 2-3X the performace *with* shaders, and *almost* 5x (6x on the best pc) the fps *without* shaders. of course thats not all, as the tps is also important. in which i consistantly get around 60% lower mspt across all systems. this modpack also beats lunar client and feather client by around 20% each while being easy to install and add to. 
*(it beat feather by 30% in some cases like singleplayer but in multiplayer only 20%. however; thats still very good).*

- also comes with controlify for controller support :3



# 

summary: install my modpack its good :)
